examples.english: Mammals is a collective term for animals that raise their young on mother's milk.

notes:
Refers to the act of feeding milk to young, either through breastfeeding or bottle-feeding. Most commonly encountered in the compound {哺乳|ほにゅう}{類|るい} (mammals), which defines the entire class of animals that nurse their young.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {哺乳|ほにゅう}{類|るい}: mammals
- {哺乳|ほにゅう}{瓶|びん}: baby bottle, nursing bottle
- {哺乳|ほにゅう}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: mammalian animal
- {哺乳|ほにゅう}{期|き}: nursing period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{授乳|じゅにゅう}→授乳：14937_junyuu⟧: breastfeeding — specifically the act of a mother nursing; more commonly used in parenting contexts than {哺乳|ほにゅう}
- ⟦{搾乳|さくにゅう}→搾乳：24182_sakunyuu⟧: milking — extracting milk from an animal or expressing breast milk with a pump
- ⟦{母乳|ぼにゅう}→母乳：13237_bonyuu⟧: breast milk — the substance itself, not the act of feeding
